kpis.description_fr: RCS = revenue récurrent in-game (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTeam, Red Dead Online microtransactions). Plus haute marge. Modèle live ops.
kpis.description_en: RCS = recurring in-game revenue (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTeam, Red Dead Online microtransactions). Higher margin. Live ops model.

kpis.description_fr: Bookings = revenu encaissé (in-game purchases + game sales) avant deferral comptable. Indicateur forward. Pic attendu 2026 avec GTA VI.
kpis.description_en: Bookings = cash collected (in-game purchases + game sales) before accounting deferral. Forward indicator. Expected 2026 peak with GTA VI.

kpis.description_fr: GTA Online MAU en décrue progressive 10 ans post-launch. Mais RCS toujours fort par user. Wait for GTA VI 2026.
kpis.description_en: GTA Online MAU progressively declining 10 years post-launch. But RCS per user still strong. Awaiting GTA VI 2026.

kpis.description_fr: Zynga acquis mai 2022 pour 12.7 Mds $. Apporte 50 % du CA bookings mobile (Words With Friends, Toon Blast). Diversification.
kpis.description_en: Zynga acquired May 2022 for $12.7B. Brings 50% of mobile bookings revenue (Words With Friends, Toon Blast). Diversification.

kpis.description_fr: GTA VI launch confirmé Q1 FY26 (avr-juin 2025 fiscal, peut être pushed à FY27). Plus gros lancement entertainment histoire. Catalyst majeur.
kpis.description_en: GTA VI launch confirmed Q1 FY26 (Apr-Jun 2025 fiscal, may push to FY27). Largest entertainment launch in history. Major catalyst.

company_description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers Kerbal Space Program; free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Top Troops, Toy Blast, Two Dots, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and hyper-casual
